cards.ex: That vintage car must have cost him a pretty penny.
cards.exUz: O'sha eski mashina unga ancha qimmatga tushgan bo'lsa kerak.
cards.uzDef: Katta miqdordagi pul, qimmat narx. Ko'pincha kutilganidan ko'proq.

cards.ex: With the recession looming, we need to tighten the purse strings.
cards.exUz: Iqtisodiy tanazzul yaqinlashayotgani sababli, biz xarajatlarni qisqartirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Xarajatlarni kamaytirish, pulni tejashga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: The bottom line is, we can't afford this project right now.
cards.exUz: Asosiy xulosa shuki, biz hozir bu loyihani moliyalashtira olmaymiz.
cards.uzDef: Asosiy natija, yakuniy hisob-kitob yoki eng muhim fakt.

cards.ex: The government had to bail out the failing bank.
cards.exUz: Hukumat bankrot bo'layotgan bankni qutqarishga majbur bo'ldi.

cards.ex: I'm investing in both stocks and bonds to hedge my bets.
cards.exUz: Men xatarni kamaytirish uchun ham aktsiyalarga, ham obligatsiyalarga sarmoya kiritayapman.
cards.uzDef: Xatarni kamaytirish uchun bir nechta variantni ko'rib chiqish.

cards.ex: Many small businesses went bust during the pandemic.
cards.exUz: Pandemiya davrida ko'plab kichik bizneslar bankrot bo'ldi.

cards.ex: Maintaining a healthy cash flow is crucial for any business.
cards.exUz: Sog'lom pul oqimini saqlash har qanday biznes uchun juda muhimdir.

cards.ex: Many families are living on the breadline due to unemployment.
cards.exUz: Ko'p oilalar ishsizlik tufayli qashshoqlikda yashamoqda.

cards.ex: We had to sell the house at a loss.
cards.exUz: Biz uyni zararga sotishga majbur bo'ldik.

cards.ex: The company was accused of a pump and dump scheme.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya aktsiyalarni soxta oshirish sxemasida ayblangan.
cards.uzDef: Aktsiya narxini sun'iy oshirib, keyin sotib yuborish.

cards.ex: The money raised was just a drop in the bucket compared to what's needed.
cards.exUz: Yig'ilgan pul kerak bo'lgan narsaga nisbatan dengizdan tomchi edi.

cards.ex: The medical bills caused a lot of financial strain on the family.
cards.exUz: Davolanish xarajatlari oilaga katta moliyaviy zo'riqish keltirdi.
cards.uzDef: Pul bilan bog'liq muammolar, moliyaviy qiyinchilik.

cards.ex: It's better to cut your losses and move on to a new project.
cards.exUz: Zararni kamaytirib, yangi loyihaga o'tish yaxshiroq.
cards.uzDef: Zararni to'xtatish uchun tez harakat qilish.

cards.ex: She's been building up her nest-egg for retirement.
cards.exUz: U nafaqaga chiqish uchun jamg'arma to'plamoqda.

cards.ex: He's penny-wise and pound-foolish; he worries about small expenses but ignores bigger financial issues.
cards.exUz: U arzonga e'tiborli, lekin katta moliyaviy muammolarga e'tibor bermaydi.
cards.uzDef: Kichik narsalarga e'tiborli, lekin katta xarajatlarni e'tiborsiz qoldirish.

cards.ex: We took out a mortgage to buy our first home.
cards.exUz: Biz birinchi uyimizni sotib olish uchun ipoteka oldik.
cards.uzDef: Uy sotib olish uchun olingan kredit.

cards.ex: A raise could push you into a higher tax bracket.
cards.exUz: Oylikning oshishi sizni yuqori soliq toifasiga o'tkazishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Daromadga qarab soliq stavkasini belgilovchi toifa.

cards.ex: Our fiscal year ends in June.
cards.exUz: Bizning moliyaviy yilimiz iyun oyida tugaydi.

cards.ex: He has a lot of liquid assets, like stocks and bonds.
cards.exUz: Uning ko'plab likvid aktivlari bor, masalan, aktsiyalar va obligatsiyalar.
cards.uzDef: Tezda pulga aylantirilishi mumkin bo'lgan aktivlar.

cards.ex: We need a large down payment to buy the house.
cards.exUz: Bizga uyni sotib olish uchun katta boshlang'ich to'lov kerak.

cards.ex: We're hoping for a good return on investment.
cards.exUz: Biz sarmoyadan yaxshi daromad olishga umid qilmoqdamiz.

cards.ex: A good credit score is important for getting a loan.
cards.exUz: Kredit olish uchun yaxshi kredit reytingi muhim.

cards.ex: The cost of living is very high in New York City.
cards.exUz: Nyu-York shahrida turmush narxi juda yuqori.

cards.ex: The company had to write off a lot of bad debt.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya ko'plab yomon qarzlarni hisobdan chiqarishga majbur bo'ldi.

cards.ex: The company is debt-ridden and struggling to survive.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya qarzlarga botgan va omon qolish uchun kurashmoqda.

cards.ex: We're currently in a bull market.
cards.exUz: Hozirda biz o'suvchi bozordamiz.

cards.ex: Investors are worried about a bear market.
cards.exUz: Investorlar pasayuvchi bozordan xavotirda.

cards.ex: High inflation is a major concern.
cards.exUz: Yuqori inflyatsiya asosiy muammo.

cards.ex: Deflation can be harmful to the economy.
cards.exUz: Deflyatsiya iqtisodiyotga zarar etkazishi mumkin.

cards.ex: If sales don't improve, the company will go belly up.
cards.exUz: Agar sotuvlar yaxshilanmasa, kompaniya bankrot bo'ladi.
